test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**equally**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage suggests that practical experience is becoming an important factor in higher education.
 
• The word "equally" fits well as it indicates that practical experience is as important as theoretical knowledge.
 
• Other options ("voicelessly", "hardly", "abruptly") do not logically convey the increasing importance of practical experience in education.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Students want (1)* *employability__* * as the primary outcome of higher education. Hence, practical experience becomes (2) __equally__ valuable to a student’s degree. Indian students are highly (3)________ at theoretical learning but lack practical training. This (4)________ an issue for decades in the Indian job market. In order to address this (5)________ issue, state governments have to take a lead. The AP government in the past three years have made efforts to bridge this long-lasting gap between theoretical and practical learning of the students.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Equally" suggests that practical experience holds the same importance as theoretical knowledge, which aligns with the passage’s focus on the growing value of practical learning.
 
• Other options like "voicelessly", "hardly", and "abruptly" do not fit the context as they do not reflect the increasing significance of practical experience.
